findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.mixer4ai.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: self_register_agent_card, check_self_registration_domain_challenge, check_self_registration_endpoint_challenge · Private data: search_published_offers, register_agent_card, self_register_agent_card, check_self_registration_domain_challenge, search_directory, approve_agent_self_registration, search_published_intents, find_verified_agent, check_self_registration_endpoint_challenge · Public sink: register_agent_card, publish_intent, approve_agent_self_registration, publish_offer · Destructive: check_self_registration_domain_challenge, approve_agent_self_registration, check_self_registration_endpoint_challenge.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: self_register_agent_card, check_self_registration_domain_challenge, check_self_registration_endpoint_challenge · Private data: search_published_offers, register_agent_card, self_register_agent_card, check_self_registration_domain_challenge, search_directory, approve_agent_self_registration, search_published_intents, find_verified_agent, check_self_registration_endpoint_challenge · Public sink: register_agent_card, publish_intent, approve_agent_self_registration, publish_offer · Destructive: check_self_registration_domain_challenge, approve_agent_self_registration, check_self_registration_endpoint_challenge

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
